about: Generic 8 in bench grinder with a belt-sander arm (the CAD's): motor and guards painted grey, the pedestal a darker cast grey; by CAD material and, inside the default one, by part: the belt, the grinding wheel, the eye shield, the tool rest, the feet.

rules.why: the sanding belt (part 27: 40 mm wide, around the arm's two wheels)
the arm's drive and idler wheels (parts 41, 89)
the tool rest at the wheel (parts 1, 2)

bgrind_paint.about: the grinder's grey enamel on its motor housing, guards and arm: smooth, orange peel (the sand-cast family read as stone at this size)

bgrind_base.about: the cast pedestal: dark grey enamel, the casting's texture softened under it

bgrind_belt.about: the sanding belt: brown-black aluminium-oxide grit

bgrind_wheel.about: a vitrified aluminium-oxide grinding wheel: grey, gritty

unsure.what: colours: the CAD paints almost everything one default lavender; machine grey assumed for the motor and guards, darker grey for the pedestal
